name: Abduction Artist
body:
Prerequisites: Ambush class feature.

Benefit: If a rogue with this talent successfully grapples a creature during a surprise round, she deals her ambush damage to that creature as either lethal or non-lethal damage, and that creature must save or suffer the ill-effect of the rogue’s ambush.
